text:
Anya: quick check — vendor says there's a short H100 hybrid slot in eu-west1 the week of Apr 5. Can we carve it for the dedicated-demo pool? Need someone to confirm quota/TF PR and whether billing/PO are ok.

Paul: opened infra PR yesterday: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/8845. Still pending billing signoff. Terraform plan failed when I ran locally:
```
Error: googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'IN_USE_ADDRESSES' exceeded for project redwood-dedicated-eu, quotaLimit: IN_USE_ADDRESSES
```

Lucas: I can review the PR. Who's owning the PO/invoicing? If billing holds, we can request temporary quota via support ticket.

vendor-bot: PO-7834 created by vendor-invoicing. Manifest ETA: 2026-04-03 09:00 UTC. Shipping note attached.

Anya: cool — once PO confirms we still need a GCP quota bump for project redwood-dedicated-eu (H100s + static addresses). @finance can you expedite the vendor invoicing path? otherwise we'll fallback to apac demo window.

finance: will ping APAC invoicing and vendor. Need cost center. @anya please post CC.

Paul: CC: INF-RED-23. Terraform PR link again: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/8845. Plan I ran (truncated):
```
# terraform plan -out=plan.tf
+ google_compute_address.static (new)
  + name = 'dedicated-demo-eu-addr'
  + region = 'eu-west1'
```
The address quota error blocks creation.

Lucas: I'll take PR review in ~2hrs. I also opened a GCP support ticket draft for quota increase: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/tickets/12345 (drafted, awaiting submit). If billing is slow we can request a 48hr emergency quota raise.

Anya: also want to pre-configure routing fallback — canary route to us-east1 if eu capacity constrained. sample config:
```
routing: {
  policy: 'prefer-eu',
  fallback: ['us-east1'],
  canary_window_minutes: 60
}
```

ops-bot: Canary switch scheduled: 2026-04-04T02:00Z -> us-east1 if eu allocation not in place. Auto-revert policy set for 6h. Will post update when triggered.

Lucas: LGTM on config. I'll leave a small comment on PR about the address resource name.

Paul: thanks team — I'll follow up with billing/vendor and update this thread once PO & quota are confirmed. :thumbsup:
